description: This Java source file defines the 'ModelTheme' class, which models a theming component for a widget framework within the OFBiz project. It handles loading theme properties, visual themes, templates, and common screens/forms/menus from XML definitions, supports inheritance from other themes, and exposes various theme-related attributes and resources.

classes.name: ModelTheme
classes.description: Represents a theming configuration for widget styles, templates, and resources in the OFBiz framework. Supports inheritance, XML-based configuration, and access to theme components such as visual themes and templates.

classes.name: ModelTemplate
classes.description: Inner class managing template rendering configs, including locations for various rendering components, and supporting template inheritance.
